

         Refactoring to linq  
                 **Ultimate C\# Masterclass Assignment**

##                  **Overview **                                                                                                                                 

| Refactor the code from the Cookie Cookbook project to use LINQ methods rather than loops. |  Refactoring |
| :---- | :---- |

The Cookies Cookbook uses a lot of loops, and at least some of them can be refactored into LINQ queries.
